## Areas we serve
### House Cleaning Services in Dubai Marina
URL: https://www.quickclean.ae/cleaning-services-dubai-marina
Part of: Dubai
Last updated: 2026-10-25

Dubai Marina is almost entirely high-rise living. Towers such as Marina Gate, Cayan Tower, Princess Tower, Marina Promenade, Park Island and the long run of buildings along Marina Walk hold tens of thousands of apartments, most of them studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom units, with a smaller number of three-bedroom apartments, duplexes and penthouses on the higher floors. Many homes here are rented, a large share are furnished holiday lets, and the turnover between tenants and guests is constant. That is exactly the kind of place where a reliable, repeatable clean matters more than anywhere else in the city.

Quick Clean provides house cleaning services in Dubai Marina for residents, landlords and short-stay hosts. Our cleaners work from the same top-to-bottom checklist on every visit: kitchen counters, hob and appliance fronts, bathrooms descaled and sanitised, floors vacuumed and mopped, dusting of surfaces and skirting, bins emptied and beds made. Deep cleans go further into grout, extractor fans, inside the oven and fridge, balcony glass and the sliding-door tracks that collect fine sand after every windy day on the water.

Marina apartments have a few quirks we plan for. Floor-to-ceiling glass and balcony railings pick up salt haze and dust quickly, so we include interior glass and balcony wipe-downs in deep cleans and can add exterior-reachable glass on request. Open-plan kitchens mean cooking residue travels further, so appliance fronts, backsplashes and the extractor hood get real attention. Most units have one or two bathrooms with glass shower screens, which we treat for limescale on every visit rather than only when it becomes visible.

Access is the main practical question in the Marina. Almost every tower has a staffed reception, visitor registration and separate service lifts, and several require a pre-registered gate pass for contractors. When you book, tell us the tower name, unit number and whether the building needs a pass or an Emirates ID copy in advance; we will arrange it before the appointment so the cleaner is not held at the desk. For furnished holiday homes we can collect and return keys from a concierge or a lockbox, and send photos when the apartment is guest-ready.

Parking is tight. Visitor bays in most towers are limited and often paid, and street parking along Marina Walk and Al Marsa Street is metered and busy. Our cleaners typically arrive by Metro (DMCC and Sobha Realty stations) or the Dubai Tram, which stops within a short walk of most buildings, so parking is rarely an issue on our side. If your building offers a contractor bay or basement visitor parking, let us know and we will use it for deep cleans that involve heavier equipment, such as carpet and upholstery extraction.

Pricing in Dubai Marina follows our standard flat-rate matrix by apartment size, shown below, so a studio or one-bedroom apartment pays the entry rate and a three-bedroom apartment pays the three-bedroom rate, with no hourly meter. Same-day and next-day slots are usually available, early-morning and evening visits suit shift workers and holiday-let turnovers, and recurring weekly or bi-weekly plans get the same cleaner each time and save up to 20% per visit.

| Property size | Basic | Standard | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Studio & 1 BR Apt | AED 200 | AED 300 | AED 350 |
| 2 BR Apartment | AED 300 | AED 400 | AED 450 |
| 3 BR Apartment | AED 400 | AED 500 | AED 550 |

FAQ:
- How much does house cleaning cost in Dubai Marina? Cleaning in Dubai Marina is priced by apartment size, not by the hour. A studio or one-bedroom apartment starts at the entry rate for the clean type you choose (Basic, Standard, Deep or Move in / out), and the full table for Marina apartment sizes is on this page. You see the flat price before you book.
- Can you get into my tower without me being there? Yes. Most Marina towers need a visitor registration or a gate pass for contractors. Give us the tower name and unit number when you book and we will arrange access in advance, collect keys from the concierge or a lockbox, and return them the same way.
- Do you clean furnished holiday homes between guests? Yes. We offer turnover cleans for short-stay apartments in Dubai Marina, including fresh linen changes where you provide the linen, restocking checks and a photo report when the apartment is guest-ready. Recurring hosts get a dedicated cleaner who knows the unit.
- Is parking a problem for your cleaners in the Marina? No. Our cleaners usually arrive by Metro or tram, so limited visitor parking does not affect your booking. For deep cleans that involve carpet-extraction equipment we will ask whether your building has a contractor or visitor bay.
- Can you book a same-day clean in Dubai Marina? Usually, yes. Same-day and next-day slots are often available for Marina apartments, including early-morning and evening visits. Book online in about a minute and pick the earliest slot that suits you.

### House Cleaning Services in Downtown Dubai
URL: https://www.quickclean.ae/cleaning-services-downtown-dubai
Part of: Dubai
Last updated: 2026-10-25

Downtown Dubai packs a huge amount of residential space into a small, busy district. Along Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard and around the Burj Khalifa you will find tower apartments in buildings such as Boulevard Central, South Ridge, 29 Boulevard, Burj Vista, Standpoint and the Opera District towers, while Old Town and Old Town Island offer lower-rise, Arabian-style buildings with larger floor plans, courtyards and more storage. Studios and one-bedroom apartments dominate the towers; two and three-bedroom apartments are common in Old Town and on the higher floors of the Boulevard buildings, and there is a steady population of serviced and short-stay apartments throughout.

Quick Clean provides house cleaning services in Downtown Dubai for owners, tenants and holiday-home operators. Every visit follows the same checklist: kitchen surfaces, hob and appliance fronts, bathrooms descaled and sanitised, floors vacuumed and mopped, dusting of furniture, ledges and skirting, bins emptied and beds made. Deep cleans add grout, inside the oven and fridge, cabinet fronts, extractor fans, interior glass and the window tracks that fill with fine dust from the constant construction and Boulevard traffic nearby.

Downtown homes are often finished to a high standard, with marble floors, glossy cabinetry and a lot of glass, so we match products to the surface. Natural stone gets a pH-neutral cleaner rather than an acidic descaler, lacquered fronts are wiped with microfibre rather than abrasive pads, and glass balustrades and balcony doors facing the fountain and the Burj are left streak-free. Many apartments here are shown to prospective tenants or guests regularly, so we pay attention to the details people notice first: mirrors, chrome, entryways and the view line through the windows.

Access in Downtown Dubai is well organised but strict. Emaar-managed towers have staffed receptions, visitor registration and in several cases a requirement for contractors to be pre-registered with the building management. When you book, give us the building name, unit number and any access rules, and we will complete the registration before the visit. For holiday homes and serviced apartments we can coordinate with the operator, collect keys from a concierge or lockbox, and send a photo report when the apartment is ready for the next guest.

Parking is possible but not free. Most Boulevard towers have basement visitor parking with ticket validation at reception, and there is paid parking along the Boulevard and in the Dubai Mall car parks, but traffic peaks around the mall and the fountain shows in the evening. Our cleaners generally arrive by Metro (Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall station) and the Dubai Mall feeder buses, so your booking is not affected by parking availability. For carpet and upholstery cleaning, which needs equipment, we will ask for a visitor bay in advance.

Pricing for Downtown Dubai follows our flat-rate matrix by apartment size, listed below, so a one-bedroom Boulevard apartment and a three-bedroom Old Town apartment each have a clear price before you confirm. Same-day and next-day appointments are usually available, early and late slots suit residents who work in DIFC and the business district, and recurring plans give you the same cleaner on every visit at up to 20% less per clean.

FAQ:
- How much does house cleaning cost in Downtown Dubai? Downtown Dubai cleaning is a flat rate by apartment size, shown in the table on this page. Studios and one-bedroom apartments pay the entry rate for the clean type you choose, larger apartments pay the rate for their size, and the price is confirmed before you book. No hourly charges.
- Do you clean Old Town and Old Town Island apartments as well as the towers? Yes. We clean apartments across Downtown Dubai, including the low-rise Old Town and Old Town Island buildings, the Boulevard towers, the Opera District and the serviced-apartment buildings around the Burj Khalifa.
- My building requires contractors to be registered. Can you handle that? Yes. Give us the building name and unit number when you book and we will complete any visitor or contractor registration with the building management before the appointment, so the cleaner is not delayed at reception.
- Are your products safe on marble floors and stone counters? Yes. Many Downtown apartments have natural stone, so we use pH-neutral cleaners on marble and stone and keep acidic descalers for ceramic, chrome and glass only. Tell us about any special surfaces when you book.
- Can I get a regular cleaner for my Downtown apartment? Yes. On weekly, bi-weekly or monthly plans we send the same vetted cleaner each visit, so they learn your apartment and your preferences. Recurring plans also save up to 20% per visit compared with one-off cleans.

### House Cleaning Services in JVC
URL: https://www.quickclean.ae/cleaning-services-jvc
Part of: Dubai
Last updated: 2026-10-25

Jumeirah Village Circle, better known as JVC, is one of the fastest-growing family communities in Dubai and one of the most varied in its housing. The circular district between Al Khail Road and Hessa Street mixes mid-rise apartment buildings, long rows of townhouses and clusters of standalone villas, all set around parks and the central village areas. Apartments run from compact studios and one-bedroom units in the newer towers to spacious two and three-bedroom family apartments; townhouses are typically two to four bedrooms over two floors, and the villas go up to five bedrooms with gardens and private garages.

Quick Clean provides house cleaning services in JVC for all three property types. Apartment visits follow our standard checklist across the kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms and living areas, with floors vacuumed and mopped and every surface dusted. Townhouse and villa cleans are planned room by room across the floors, including staircases, landings, the maid's room if used as storage, and the ground-floor areas that collect the most sand. Deep cleans add grout, inside appliances, cabinet fronts, extractor fans, window tracks and the glass that overlooks the garden or the community park.

JVC is still being built out, and that shapes what our cleaners find. Homes in newer buildings and recently handed-over townhouses often carry a fine layer of construction dust on ledges, inside cabinets and along the tops of doors and wardrobes, which a normal weekly wipe never fully removes. We recommend a deep clean or a move-in clean as the first visit in any JVC home that is new or has been empty, then a Standard clean on a recurring schedule. Families with children and pets, who make up a large share of the community, tend to choose weekly or bi-weekly plans.

Access and parking are easier in JVC than in the tower districts. Most apartment buildings have a caretaker or small reception rather than a formal gate-pass system, and townhouses and villas are reached directly from the street or a private driveway. There is usually free on-street or visitor parking close to the building, which lets our cleaners bring equipment for carpet, upholstery and deep cleans without arrangement. Tell us the building or cluster name and any access code or caretaker contact when you book, and whether a garden, balcony or garage should be included.

One practical note for JVC residents: the community sits beside major roads and open desert, so dust builds up fast on balconies, window sills and external glass, and sandy footprints reach the ground floor on every windy day. We mop hard floors on every visit as standard, and we can add balcony and sill cleaning to a recurring plan so the outdoor areas stay usable all year.

Pricing in JVC follows our flat-rate matrix by home size, shown below, which covers everything from a studio apartment to a five-bedroom villa. Same-day and next-day slots are usually available, and because the community is central to our cleaners' routes, morning, afternoon and evening appointments are all easy to arrange. Recurring customers get the same cleaner each time and save up to 20% on every visit.

### House Cleaning Services in Business Bay
URL: https://www.quickclean.ae/cleaning-services-business-bay
Part of: Dubai
Last updated: 2026-10-25

Business Bay stretches along both banks of the Dubai Water Canal, just south of Downtown, and is a true mixed-use district: residential towers, serviced apartments, hotels and office buildings sit side by side, often in the same tower. Residential stock is dominated by studios and one-bedroom apartments in buildings such as the Executive Towers, DAMAC Towers by Paramount, Bay Square, Churchill Towers, Vera and the newer canal-front developments, with two and three-bedroom apartments on the higher floors and in the family-oriented towers. A large share of homes are furnished and let on short or medium terms, and a significant number of residents also work in the district.

Quick Clean provides house cleaning in Business Bay for residents, landlords and holiday-let operators, and after-hours office cleaning for the businesses that share these towers. Residential visits follow our standard checklist in the kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms and living space, with floors vacuumed and mopped and surfaces dusted, and deep cleans add grout, inside appliances, extractor fans, interior glass and balcony doors. Office visits are built around your own checklist: workstations, meeting rooms, pantry, washrooms and reception, scheduled in the evening or early morning so your team never sees a cleaner at work.

Apartments in Business Bay tend to be compact, modern and heavy on glass, with open kitchens that put cooking residue on more surfaces than a closed kitchen would. We give appliance fronts, backsplashes and extractor hoods proper attention on every visit, keep glass shower screens free of limescale, and leave the balcony doors and canal-facing windows streak-free. Access in Business Bay is tower-managed. For offices we can hold keys or access cards under a signed agreement so that recurring evening cleans run without anyone needing to stay late.

Parking is limited and mostly paid. Visitor bays in the towers are scarce, and the surrounding streets are metered and congested during office hours, with heavy traffic at the Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road junctions at peak times. Our cleaners typically arrive by Metro (Business Bay station) or on foot from Downtown, so parking does not affect residential bookings. For carpet and upholstery cleaning or large office jobs that need equipment, we will ask for a loading bay or a visitor space in advance.

### House Cleaning Services in Sharjah
URL: https://www.quickclean.ae/cleaning-services-sharjah
Part of: United Arab Emirates
Last updated: 2026-10-25

Sharjah is home to a huge number of families who want a bigger home than the same budget buys in Dubai, and the housing reflects that. The apartment districts of Al Nahda, Al Taawun, Al Majaz, Al Khan, Al Qasimia and Abu Shagara are full of mid and high-rise buildings with generous two and three-bedroom apartments, many with maid's rooms and large kitchens, while Muwaileh, University City and the newer Aljada and Al Zahia developments add modern one to three-bedroom apartments and townhouses. Villa areas such as Al Falaj, Al Ramtha, Al Fisht, Sharjah Garden City and Al Rahmaniya hold three to six-bedroom family villas with gardens, majlis rooms and multiple bathrooms.

Quick Clean provides house cleaning services across Sharjah for apartments, townhouses and villas. Every visit covers the kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms and living areas, with floors vacuumed and mopped and surfaces dusted, and larger homes are planned floor by floor so nothing is missed on landings, staircases, the majlis or the guest bathrooms. Deep cleans add grout, inside the oven and fridge, cabinet fronts, extractor fans, ceiling fans, window tracks and the balcony or courtyard surfaces that collect sand after every windy day.

Sharjah homes are typically larger and busier than Dubai apartments, with more bathrooms, more kitchen use and more foot traffic, so we size each visit to the property rather than to a fixed number of hours. A three-bedroom apartment in Al Majaz with three bathrooms is priced and planned differently from a studio, and a six-bedroom villa in Al Ramtha is scheduled with the right number of cleaners to finish in one visit. Access in Sharjah is straightforward in most districts. ### House Cleaning Services in Dubai South
URL: https://www.quickclean.ae/cleaning-services-dubai-south
Part of: Dubai
Last updated: 2026-10-25

Dubai South is the newest large district in the city, laid out around Al Maktoum International Airport and the old Expo site. Most residents live in the Residential District, where mid rise buildings such as MAG 5 Boulevard and The Pulse Residence sit close to the schools, the clinic and the community shops. Across Expo Road, Emaar South adds golf course villas and townhouses. Homes run from studios and one bedroom apartments up to three bedroom family apartments, with townhouses of three or four bedrooms and villas of four or five bedrooms in Emaar South and the Pulse townhouse clusters.

Because so much of the district is still being built, dust is the main cleaning problem. New handover homes arrive with a fine grey film inside cupboards, on top of wardrobes and along the window frames, and a normal wipe does not shift it. Open desert on three sides keeps adding sand to balconies and ground floor rooms whenever the wind picks up. Townhouses in The Pulse and Emaar South also have small gardens and covered parking bays that collect grit, and the pale tiles used in most of the newer buildings show every footprint.

Quick Clean covers all of Dubai South, including the Residential District, The Pulse, Emaar South and the staff housing near the logistics district. Apartment visits follow our full checklist for the kitchen, the bathrooms, the bedrooms and the living space, with floors vacuumed and mopped and every reachable surface dusted. For townhouses and villas we plan the visit floor by floor and add the garden patio, the garage floor and the outside of the ground floor windows when you ask for them. We also clean the furnished apartments that airlines and logistics companies rent for staff, where a quick turnover between occupants matters more than anything else.

Access is simple here. Parking is free and plentiful, usually right outside the building, so our cleaners can bring extraction machines for carpet and sofa cleaning without any arrangement. The one thing to plan around is distance. Dubai South is a 35 to 45 minute drive from central Dubai, so we group visits by day and give you a firm arrival window rather than a vague morning or afternoon.

The right first visit for almost every home in Dubai South is a deep clean or a move in clean. Expo City Dubai is the neighbourhood that grew out of the Expo 2020 site, and it is one of the few places in Dubai where you can walk to almost everything. The homes are all apartments. Quick Clean provides house cleaning across Expo City, from Expo Village to the newest towers. URL: https://www.quickclean.ae/cleaning-services-jebel-ali
Part of: Dubai
Last updated: 2026-10-25

Jebel Ali is two very different places that share a name. Jebel Ali Village, on the Sheikh Zayed Road side near Ibn Battuta Mall, is a quiet villa community that Nakheel has rebuilt with large four and five bedroom family villas on wide plots, with a few of the older bungalows still standing nearby. Jebel Ali Industrial Area and the Free Zone, towards the port, are mostly workplaces, but they also hold a lot of staff accommodation and a scattering of apartment buildings where people who work at the port, the Free Zone or the airport live in studios, one bedroom and two bedroom apartments.

The cleaning problems follow the geography. In the Village, the villas have big gardens, driveways, maid rooms and multiple bathrooms, and the sand from the open land and the coast blows across patios and into ground floor rooms on windy days. Pools and outdoor seating areas gather grit and leaves. In the Industrial Area, the issue is fine dark dust from the roads and the port, which settles on window sills and balcony floors faster than anywhere else in the city, and older apartment kitchens that need degreasing more often than new ones. Many of the Village villas also have outdoor kitchens and barbecue areas that need a proper degrease after a weekend of guests.

Quick Clean covers both Jebel Ali Village and the Industrial Area, including the Free Zone residential buildings. Villa visits are planned floor by floor and staffed for the size of the house, so a five bedroom villa with a maid room and five bathrooms is finished in one visit rather than rushed. Deep cleans add grout, the insides of the oven and fridge, cabinet fronts, extractor fans and ceiling fans.

Access and parking are easy throughout. Village villas are reached from the street with a driveway for our cleaners to use, and most apartment buildings in the Industrial Area have a watchman rather than a formal reception, so no pass is needed. Free parking is available almost everywhere, which means carpet, sofa and mattress cleaning with extraction equipment needs no arrangement. The Jebel Ali and Ibn Battuta metro stations on the Red Line serve the Village side, and our cleaners use them for regular visits when they do not need to bring equipment.

For a villa in Jebel Ali Village that has just been handed over or has been empty, the right first visit is a deep clean. For an apartment near the port, a Standard clean is usually enough to start, with a deep clean added if the kitchen has not been degreased for a while. Recurring customers in the Village mostly choose a weekly Standard clean with the garden patio included, while apartment residents in the Industrial Area tend to book a Basic or Standard clean every two weeks. ### House Cleaning Services in Al Furjan
URL: https://www.quickclean.ae/cleaning-services-al-furjan
Part of: Dubai
Last updated: 2026-10-25

Al Furjan sits between Discovery Gardens and Jebel Ali Village, just off Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and it has grown from a quiet villa community into one of the busiest residential areas in new Dubai. The original Nakheel villas and townhouses come in two styles, Quortaj and Dubai Style, with three to five bedrooms, private gardens and covered parking. Around them, a wave of apartment buildings from Azizi, Danube and other developers has added studios, one bedroom and two bedroom apartments, with a few three bedroom units, mostly along the main loop roads and near the Al Furjan Pavilion.

Living here means living with construction for a while longer. Dust from the building sites drifts into villas and apartments alike, settling on window sills, balcony floors and the tops of cupboards within days of a clean. Villa owners also deal with gardens that shed leaves and soil onto patios, outdoor furniture that needs wiping down and sand that blows in from the open plots nearby. In the apartment buildings, the main issues are new handover dust and kitchens with open layouts that spread cooking residue onto nearby surfaces.

Quick Clean provides house cleaning across Al Furjan, from the original villa phases to the newest apartment towers. Villa and townhouse visits are planned floor by floor and cover every bedroom and bathroom, the maid room, the staircase and the living areas, with the garden patio and garage added on request. Apartment visits follow the same full checklist for the kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms and living space. Deep cleans include grout, the insides of the oven and fridge, cabinet fronts, vents and the tracks of the sliding doors that fill with sand. Townhouse staircases and the landings outside the bedrooms get a proper vacuum and mop on every visit rather than a quick sweep.

Access is easy for villas and townhouses, which are reached from the street with a driveway to park in, and straightforward in most apartment buildings, which have a reception or watchman but rarely a formal pass system. Free parking is available around most buildings, although the streets near the Pavilion get busy in the evenings. The Al Furjan metro station on the Route 2020 line and Discovery Gardens station next door mean our cleaners can arrive by train for regular visits and drive only when they bring equipment for carpet or sofa cleaning. If your villa has a side gate to the garden, leave it unlocked on the day and the cleaner can work outside without going through the house.

For a newly handed over apartment or villa, book a move in clean or a deep clean first to clear the construction dust properly. For a home you already live in, a Standard clean is the right start. Discovery Gardens is a large, low rise apartment community next to Ibn Battuta Mall, built by Nakheel in themed clusters with names like Mediterranean, Zen, Contemporary, Mogul, Cactus and Mesoamerican. Almost every home here is a studio, a one bedroom or a two bedroom apartment, with a small number of larger units in the newer buildings on the edges. It is one of the most affordable places to live in new Dubai, so the residents are a mix of young professionals, couples and small families, and many share apartments. The clusters are arranged around landscaped gardens and walkways, which is pleasant but means plenty of dust and pollen find their way inside through open balcony doors.

The buildings are now fifteen years old or more, and that shows in the cleaning. Bathrooms have older grout and fittings that need regular descaling, kitchens are compact with limited ventilation so grease builds up on cabinet fronts and the extractor, and the window frames and balconies collect dust from Sheikh Zayed Road and the open land towards Al Furjan. Humidity from the air conditioning in the summer leaves a film on mirrors and glass. Pets are common, which adds hair on floors and fabric to the list.

Quick Clean provides house cleaning throughout Discovery Gardens. Because the apartments are compact, a visit is efficient, and we use the time on the places that matter most here. Kitchens are degreased, including the extractor hood and the cabinet fronts, bathrooms are descaled and sanitised, floors are vacuumed and mopped, and the balcony and window frames are wiped. Deep cleans go into grout, the insides of the oven and fridge, the air conditioning vents and the gaps behind appliances where dust and crumbs collect in small kitchens. Mattress and sofa cleaning is a popular add on in shared apartments, where furniture passes from one tenant to the next.

Access is simple. Each building has a caretaker or a small reception and no visitor pass system, so our cleaners can go straight up. Parking is open air around the clusters and free, but it fills up in the evenings and on weekends, so we prefer daytime slots for visits that involve equipment. Discovery Gardens has its own metro station on the Route 2020 line, and Ibn Battuta station is a short walk from the eastern clusters, which is how most of our cleaners arrive for regular visits.

For an apartment you have just moved into, a move in clean is the right first visit because it covers the inside of cupboards and the appliances that previous tenants rarely clean thoroughly. For a home you already live in, a Standard clean is a good start, with a deep clean added if the kitchen or bathrooms have not had a proper descale in a while. Jumeirah Lake Towers, which everyone in Dubai calls JLT, is a dense district of more than 80 towers arranged around three lakes, directly across Sheikh Zayed Road from Dubai Marina. Homes are almost all apartments, mostly studios, one bedroom and two bedroom units, with three bedroom apartments and duplexes in the larger towers. JLT apartments share the cleaning issues of any busy tower district, with a few of their own. Floor to ceiling glass facing the lakes shows every smear and picks up dust from the constant traffic on Sheikh Zayed Road and First Al Khail Street. Open kitchens send cooking residue onto nearby surfaces. The older towers from the first phase have bathrooms with grout and glass screens that need regular descaling. Many apartments are rented furnished or used as short stay lets, so turnovers between tenants and guests are frequent. Quick Clean provides house cleaning across every JLT cluster. Dubai Sports City sits between Hessa Street and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, built around the Dubai International Stadium, the Els Club golf course and a cluster of sports academies. Towers such as Canal Residence, Elite Residence, Hub Canal, Golf View, Royal Residence and the Giovanni Boutique Suites hold studios and one, two and three bedroom apartments, many with views over the golf course or the canal. Last updated: 2026-10-25

Deira and Bur Dubai are the oldest parts of the city, facing each other across the Creek. Deira takes in Al Rigga, Al Muraqqabat, Port Saeed, Naif, Al Baraha, Hor Al Anz, Abu Hail and Al Garhoud, and Bur Dubai covers Al Karama, Al Mankhool, Oud Metha, Al Hamriya, Al Raffa, Al Fahidi, Al Jaddaf and Satwa. Homes here are almost all apartments in mid rise buildings, from compact studios to roomy two and three bedroom family apartments, many of them twenty or thirty years old with high ceilings and big kitchens. Shared apartments are common, and so are families who have lived in the same building for a decade.

Cleaning in the old city is about age and density. Kitchens in older buildings have years of grease on the extractor, the tiles and the cabinet fronts, bathrooms have fittings and grout that need regular descaling, and the humidity near the Creek leaves mildew in bathrooms and a film on glass. Dust from the busy streets settles on sills and balconies quickly, and the older lifts and stairwells mean carrying equipment takes longer. Many apartments are shared by several working adults, so the common areas take the most wear.

Quick Clean provides house cleaning across Deira and Bur Dubai. Every visit covers the kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms and living space, with extra time on degreasing the kitchen and descaling the bathrooms because that is where older apartments need it most, and with floors vacuumed and mopped and the balcony wiped. Deep cleans go into grout, the insides of the oven and fridge, cabinet fronts, the extractor fan, ceiling fans, the window frames and the gaps behind appliances. For shared apartments we can agree a checklist that covers the common areas and the rooms you want. Mattress and sofa cleaning is popular in furnished apartments that pass from one tenant to the next.

Access is simple, because the older buildings have a watchman rather than a reception or a pass system, so our cleaners can go straight up once you have told the watchman to expect them. Parking is the hardest part of working in the old city. Nearly every street is a paid RTA zone and spaces are scarce during the day, so our cleaners arrive by metro for regular visits. Union, Al Rigga, Salah Al Din, Abu Baker Al Siddique, BurJuman, Al Fahidi, Oud Metha and ADCB stations put almost every building within a ten minute walk. For deep cleans with equipment we drive and plan the visit for a quieter time of day.

For an apartment in an older building, the right first visit is a deep clean to reset the kitchen, the bathrooms and the grout, after which a Standard clean every two weeks keeps it in shape. For a newly rented apartment, book a move in clean first. Recurring customers in Deira and Bur Dubai are mostly families on a two weekly Standard plan and shared apartments on a two weekly Basic plan split between flatmates, with a deep clean added once a year.

Prices follow the flat table below for the apartment sizes found in Deira and Bur Dubai, from a studio to a three bedroom apartment, with no surcharge for the area. Same day and next day slots are usually available because the old city is well connected by metro, early morning and evening visits suit shift workers, and recurring customers keep the same cleaner on every visit.

FAQ:
- How much does apartment cleaning cost in Deira or Bur Dubai? It is a flat rate by apartment size, from a studio to a three bedroom apartment, and the table on this page shows every rate. There is no surcharge for the old city. The price is confirmed before you book.
- Can you deal with years of grease in an old kitchen? Yes. A deep clean degreases the extractor, the tiles, the cabinet fronts and the inside of the oven, which is the right first visit for most older apartments in Deira and Bur Dubai. After that a Standard clean every two weeks keeps it in shape.
- Do you clean shared apartments? Yes. We can clean the whole apartment or agree a checklist that covers the kitchen, bathrooms and living room plus the rooms you choose, and flatmates often split a Basic clean every two weeks. Tell us how the apartment is shared when you book.
- How do your cleaners handle parking in Deira and Bur Dubai? For regular visits they arrive by metro, since stations such as Union, Al Rigga, BurJuman, Al Fahidi and Oud Metha put almost every building within a ten minute walk. For deep cleans with equipment we drive and plan the visit for a quieter time of day.
- Do I need to arrange building access for the cleaner? Usually you just tell the watchman to expect us, because most older buildings have no reception or pass system. If your building is newer and has visitor registration, send us the building name and we will arrange it in advance.

## General FAQ
- Do I need to be home during the clean? No. Most customers give us secure access instructions and come home to a spotless space. You are welcome to be there if you prefer.
- What if I am not happy with the clean? Just let us know within 24 hours and we will send someone back to re-clean the area free. That is our 100% Spotless Guarantee.
- Are your cleaners insured and background-checked? Yes. Every Quick Clean pro is interviewed, background-checked, trained, and fully insured and bonded before they ever enter a home.
- Do you bring your own supplies? Yes. We arrive with professional, eco-friendly products and equipment. Have a preferred product? Just leave it out and let us know.
- How do I pay, and when? Securely online after the clean is done and you are happy. No cash needed, no payment up front, and no contracts.
- How much does house cleaning cost with Quick Clean? Every plan is a flat rate by unit type. Basic starts at AED 200 for a studio or one bedroom apartment, Standard at AED 300 and Premium at AED 350, and the pricing page lists every unit type from a studio up to a six bedroom villa. Deep cleans and move in or move out cleans are quoted for your property before you book.
- Which areas do you serve? Quick Clean serves Dubai, Sharjah, and Ajman — including Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, JVC, Business Bay, and surrounding communities.
- How long does a house cleaning take? A standard clean usually takes about 1.5 to 3 hours, depending on the size and condition of your home. Deep cleans and move-in/move-out cleans take longer. You will get an estimated time when you book.
- Can I book a same-day or next-day cleaning? Yes. Same-day and next-day appointments are often available. You can book online in about 60 seconds and choose the earliest time slot that works for you.
- What types of properties do you clean? We clean apartments, villas, townhouses, and studios, as well as offices and commercial spaces. The same 100% Spotless Guarantee applies to every property type and size.
- What is included in a standard cleaning? A standard clean covers your kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas — dusting, vacuuming, mopping, wiping surfaces and counters, emptying bins, and tidying. Extras like inside the oven or baseboards can be added as a deep clean.
- What is the difference between a standard clean and a deep clean? A standard clean maintains an already-tidy home. A deep clean is more thorough and adds baseboards, grout, vents, and inside or behind appliances. Many customers start with a deep clean, then switch to recurring standard cleans.
- How often should I schedule a cleaning? Most households choose bi-weekly cleaning. Homes with kids or pets often prefer weekly, while lighter homes do well with monthly visits. Recurring plans save up to 20% per visit.
- Are your cleaning products safe for children and pets? Yes. We use professional, eco-friendly, non-toxic products that are safe around children and pets. If you prefer specific products, just leave them out and let us know.
- Can I request the same cleaner every time? Yes. On recurring plans we send the same vetted cleaner who already knows your home and your preferences.
- What payment methods do you accept? You pay securely online by credit or debit card after the clean is finished and you are happy with it. No cash is needed and no payment is taken up front.
- Can I reschedule or cancel my cleaning? Yes. You can reschedule or cancel anytime from your booking confirmation. There are no contracts and no cancellation fees — we just appreciate a little notice when possible.
- What happens if something is damaged during the clean? Quick Clean is fully insured and bonded. In the rare event something is damaged, let us know within 24 hours and we will make it right.
- Do you offer office or commercial cleaning? Yes. We provide after-hours office and commercial cleaning on a custom recurring schedule. Request a free walkthrough and we will send you a flat quote.
